#Depth across sites 
```{r}
#mean depth across sites 
mean(transects$mean_depth_m) #6.4m 
max(transects$mean_depth_m) #11.0 m 
min(transects$depth_m) #0.7m 

#determining shallowest and deepest site 
#group by site and calculate the mean depth per site
mean_depth_summary <- transects %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_depth_m = mean(mean_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE)  # Mean depth for each site
  )

#find the shallowest site (minimum mean depth)
shallowest_site <- mean_depth_summary %>%
  filter(mean_depth_m == min(mean_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE))


#find the deepest site (maximum mean depth)
deepest_site <- mean_depth_summary %>%
  filter(mean_depth_m == max(mean_depth_m, na.rm = TRUE))


shallowest_site #Ellis N 5.2m 
deepest_site #Taylor 7.8m 
```

#Urchin densities by species (across sites) ###
```{r}
#reshape the data to long format for stacking
transects_long <- transects %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(red_density, green_density, purple_density), 
               names_to = "species", 
               values_to = "density")

#explicitly set the factor levels for 'species' if necessary
transects_long$species <- factor(transects_long$species, 
                                          levels = c("red_density", "green_density", "purple_density"))

#create the stacked bar plot
plot <- ggplot(transects_long, aes(x = site, y = density, fill = species)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  labs(
    title = "Urchin Densities by Species", 
    x = "Site", 
    y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red_density" = "red", "green_density" = "green", "purple_density" = "purple")) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) #rotate x-axis labels for readability

plot 

#save
ggsave("/Users/tessarehill/Dropbox/MSc/Exclosures/plots/urchin_densities/densities_by_sp.png", plot = plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

#mostly red urchins, probably don't need to visualize this.
unique(transects$total_n_gu) #one occurence of green urchin
unique(transects$total_n_pu) #three occurences of purple urchin

```

#Are urchin densities significantly different across sites? 
```{r}
#testing to see if urchin densities are statistically different from each other 
#check normality of urchin densities per site, if greater than p>0.05 the data is normal 
shapiro.test(transects$urchin_site_density) #p = 0.1757, normal

#homogeneity of variances, if less than 0.05 variances are significantly different than each other
leveneTest(urchin_site_density ~ site, data = transects) #p = 0.0513, marginal 

#conduct another test to test variances 
#run the Brown-Forsythe test
bf_test <- bf.test(urchin_site_density ~ site, data = transects)

#display the results, 
bf_test #variances are NOT equal across groups

#unequal variances, so we'll use a kruschal test, if p<0.05 there is significance 
kruskal.test(urchin_site_density ~ site, data = transects) #p = 0.003271

#determine which sites are significantly different from each other, use Dunn's test 
#Dunn's test for pairwise comparisons
#this is how we can determine threshold for 'low', 'med', 'high' urchin densities 
dunn.test(transects$urchin_site_density, transects$site, kw = TRUE, label = TRUE) 

#significant differences; 
  #Ellis S v Nanat
  #Nanat v Taylor 
  #Taylor v Ellis S

#non-significant 
  #Ed king v Dixon 
  #Ellis S v Ellis N 
  #Taylor v Ellis N
  #Taylor v Ed King 

#set the desired order for the sites
transects$site <- factor(transects$site, 
                                 levels = c("Taylor", "Ed King", "Dixon", "Ellis N", "Ellis S", "Nanat"))
#visualize via boxplot 
plot <- ggplot(transects, aes(x = site, y = urchin_site_density)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Urchin Density Across Sites",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot 

#save
ggsave("/Users/tessarehill/Dropbox/MSc/Exclosures/plots/urchin_densities/bw_box_densities_by_site.png", plot = plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

#color based on urchin density 
plot <- ggplot(transects, aes(x = site, y = urchin_site_density, fill = site)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Nanat" = "green", 
    "Dixon" = "orange", 
    "Ellis S" = "orange", 
    "Ellis N" = "orange", 
    "Ed King" = "orange", 
    "Taylor" = "red"
  )) + 
  labs(
    title = "Urchin Density Across Sites", 
    x = "Site", 
    y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis labels for readability
  guides(fill = "none")  # Remove the legend

plot 
#save
ggsave("/Users/tessarehill/Dropbox/MSc/Exclosures/plots/urchin_densities/box_densities_by_site.png", plot = plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

#Density analysis (same as above, do urchin densities differ by site, but remove March and August data)
  #its reasonable to keep month of March even if TR and EK were not surveyed 
```{r}

transects_new <- transects %>%
  filter(!month %in% c("March", "August"))

#testing to see if urchin densities are statistically different from each other 
#check normality of urchin densities per site, if greater than p>0.05 the data is normal 
shapiro.test(transects_new$urchin_site_density) #data is normal

#homogeneity of variances, if less than 0.05 variances are significantly different than each other
leveneTest(urchin_site_density ~ site, data = transects_new) #NOT significantly different from each other

#since conditions for a one-way ANOVA are met 
#run ANOVA to compare urchin densities across sites
anova_result <- aov(urchin_site_density ~ site, data = transects_new)
summary(anova_result) #significant differences in urchin densities across sites 

#post-hoc pairwise comparisons
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
tukey_result

#significant differences between 
  #taylor and all sites 
  #ellis S and Nanat
  #ellis S and Ed King/Dixon

#set the desired order for the sites
transects_new$site <- factor(transects_new$site, 
                                 levels = c("Taylor", "Ed King", "Dixon", "Ellis N", "Ellis S", "Nanat"))
#visualize via boxplot 
plot <- ggplot(transects_new, aes(x = site, y = urchin_site_density)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Urchin Density Across Sites",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot

#create a sample dataset
data_legend <- data.frame(
  Site = c("Nanat", "Dixon", "Ellis S", "Ellis N", "Ed King", "Taylor"),
  x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6),  # Example x-coordinates
  y = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)   # Example y-coordinates
)

# Reorder the Site factor to ensure Taylor appears first

# Define colors and shapes
colors <- c("Nanat" = "#4da607", 
            "Dixon" = "#f9cd44", 
            "Ellis S" = "#4da607", 
            "Ellis N" = "#f9cd44", 
            "Ed King" = "#f9cd44", 
            "Taylor" = "#cd3737")

shapes <- c("Nanat" = 15,  # Square
            "Ellis S" = 15,  # Square
            "Dixon" = 16,  # Circle
            "Ellis N" = 16,  # Circle
            "Ed King" = 16,  # Circle
            "Taylor" = 17)  # Triangle

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(data_legend, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Site, shape = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +  # Adjust size for better visibility
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +

# Save the plot
ggsave("/Users/tessarehill/Dropbox/MSc/Exclosures/plots/urchin_densities/legend_densities.png", 
       plot = plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

#define categories
low_density_sites <- c("Nanat", "Ellis S")
medium_density_sites <- c("Ed King", "Dixon", "Ellis N")
high_density_sites <- c("Taylor")

#group data by category and calculate min/max urchin density
urchin_density_summary <- transects_new %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    site %in% low_density_sites ~ "Low",
    site %in% medium_density_sites ~ "Medium",
    site %in% high_density_sites ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    min_density = min(urchin_site_density, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_density = max(urchin_site_density, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#print results
print(urchin_density_summary)
```

```{r}
#calculate mean urchin density per site

  group_by(site) %>%

overall_mean_density <- mean(transects$urchin_site_density, na.rm = TRUE)
overall_mean_density #1.42


# Define custom color palette
site_colors <- c("Taylor" = "#cd3737",  
                 "Ed King" = "#f9cd44",  
                 "Dixon" = "#f9cd44",  
                 "Ellis N" = "#f9cd44",  
                 "Ellis S" = "#4da607",  
                 "Nanat" = "#4da607")

# Define custom shape mapping
site_shapes <- c("Nanat" = 15,   # Green square
                 "Ellis S" = 15, # Green square
                 "Ed King" = 16, # Yellow circle
                 "Ellis N" = 16, # Yellow circle
                 "Dixon" = 16,   # Yellow circle
                 "Taylor" = 17)  # Red triangle

# Reorder site factor levels to ensure Taylor appears first in the legend
transects$site <- factor(transects$site, levels = c("Taylor", "Nanat", "Ellis S", "Dixon", "Ellis N", "Ed King"))
mean_urchin_density$site <- factor(mean_urchin_density$site, levels = c("Taylor", "Nanat", "Ellis S", "Dixon", "Ellis N", "Ed King"))

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(transects, aes(x = month, y = urchin_site_density, color = site, group = site, shape = site)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +   # Line plot for each site
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Add points for each month/site combination
  
  # Plot site mean values as points
  geom_point(data = mean_urchin_density,
             aes(x = "mean", y = mean_density, color = site, shape = site),
             size = 4, show.legend = TRUE) +  

  # Add labels for site mean values with better positioning
  geom_text_repel(data = mean_urchin_density,
                  aes(x = "mean", y = mean_density, label = round(mean_density, 2), color = site),
                  vjust = -1, hjust = -0.2, size = 5, show.legend = FALSE,  
                  box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 10) +  

  # Add the overall mean line and text
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = overall_mean_density), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +  
  geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = overall_mean_density, 
                label = paste("Overall Mean:", round(overall_mean_density, 2))),
            color = "black", vjust = 2.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +  

  # Labels and custom colors/shapes
  labs(
    title = "Urchin Density by Month Across Sites",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("March", "April", "May", "June", "mean")) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = site_colors) +  
  scale_shape_manual(values = site_shapes) +  # Apply custom shapes
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),  
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),  
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)  
  )

# Display the plot
print(plot)

#save the plot as a PNG file
ggsave("/Users/tessarehill/Dropbox/MSc/Exclosures/plots/urchin_densities/densities_month_site_col.png", 
       plot = plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

#Were cages effective at reducing urchins?
#Did urchin densities vary significantly between caged and open plots?
```{r}
#Were cages effective at reducing grazers? 
#Did urchin densities vary significantly between caged and uncaged plots, irrelavant of site or month 

#check distribution of urchin density data - histogram
ggplot(plots, aes(x = urchin_density)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of urchin density by treatment", x = "Urchin Density", y = "Count")

#shapiro-Wilk test for normality, p less than 0.05, normally distributed
shapiro.test(plots$urchin_density[plots$treatment == "caged"]) #normally distributed 
shapiro.test(plots$urchin_density[plots$treatment == "open"]) #normally distributed 

#t-test to compare urchin densities between treatments
t_test_result  <- t.test(urchin_density ~ treatment, data = plots) 
t_test_result

p_value <- formatC(t_test_result$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)
#calculate values for reporting 
#calculate the mean and standard error for each treatment
summary_stats <- plots %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(urchin_density, na.rm = TRUE),  # Mean of urchin density
    sd_density = sd(urchin_density, na.rm = TRUE),      # Standard deviation of urchin density
    n = n(),                                           # Sample size
    sem = sd_density / sqrt(n)                         # Standard error of the mean
  )

#print summary statistics to check the results
print(summary_stats)

#get values for open and caged treatments
open_stats <- summary_stats %>% filter(treatment == "open")
caged_stats <- summary_stats %>% filter(treatment == "caged")

#calculate and format the report output
open_report <- paste(open_stats$mean_density, "±", round(open_stats$sem, 2), "ind/m²")
caged_report <- paste(caged_stats$mean_density, "±", round(caged_stats$sem, 2), "ind/m²")

#make a barchat instead - plots mean and standard deviation 
# Calculate mean and standard deviation for each treatment
summary_stats <- plots %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_urchin_density = mean(urchin_density, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_urchin_density = sd(urchin_density, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),  # Sample size
        se_urchin_density = sd_urchin_density / sqrt(n)  # Standard error
    )

# Create the bar chart with mean and standard error
plot <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = treatment, y = mean_urchin_density, fill = treatment, pattern = treatment)) +
    geom_bar_pattern(
        stat = "identity", 
        position = position_dodge(), 
        width = 0.7,
        pattern_density = 0.05,       # Adjust pattern density
        pattern_spacing = 0.05,       # Adjust spacing of the pattern
        pattern_fill = "black",       # Color of pattern lines
        pattern_color = "black",      # Border color of pattern
        pattern_angle = 45            # Angle of cross-hatching
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = pmax(mean_urchin_density - se_urchin_density, 0),  # Ensure lower bound is zero
            ymax = mean_urchin_density + se_urchin_density
        ),
        width = 0.2,  # Width of the error bar
        color = "black",
        position = position_dodge(0.7)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Urchin Density by Treatment",
        x = "Treatment",
        y = "Urchin Density (m²)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("caged" = "#FF5733", "open" = "#076fa6")) +  # Color fill
    scale_pattern_manual(values = c("caged" = "crosshatch", "open" = "none")) +  # Apply pattern only to "caged"
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),  # Increase title size
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),  # Increase x-axis text size
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),  # Increase y-axis text size
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),  # Increase x-axis label size
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")  # Increase y-axis label size
    )

plot
```

#Site grazer density 
```{r}
#Assuming 'transects' is your dataframe
#Create a plot of urchin site density by site

# Select relevant columns and reshape the data
grazers_summary <- transects %>%
  dplyr::select(site, total_n_ru, total_n_gu, total_n_pu, total_n_sn, total_n_pyc, total_n_ab) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -site, names_to = "grazer", values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(count = count,  # Keep raw count
         proportion = count / sum(count))  # Calculate proportions per site

# Define custom colors
grazer_colors <- c(
  "total_n_pu" = "#8a54b3",  # Purple Urchin
  "total_n_gu" = "#4da607",  # Green Urchin
  "total_n_ru" = "#cd3737",  # Red Urchin
  "total_n_pyc" = "#f9cd44", # Pycnopodia
  "total_n_ab" = "#076fa6",  # Abalone
  "total_n_sn" = "#62a4ea"   # Snail
)

# Create the proportional stacked bar chart
ggplot(grazers_summary, aes(x = site, y = proportion, fill = grazer)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = grazer_colors, labels = c("Abalone", "Green Urchin", "Purple Urchin", "Pycnopodia",  "Red Urchin",  "Turban Snail")) +
  labs(x = "Site", y = "Proportion of Grazers", fill = "Grazer Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#Turban snails densities 
```{r}
#Were cages effective at reducing grazers? 
#Did urchin densities vary significantly between caged and uncaged plots, irrelavant of site or month 

#check distribution of urchin density data - histogram
ggplot(plots, aes(x = ts_density)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of turban snail density by treatment", x = "Snail Density", y = "Count")

#shapiro-Wilk test for normality, p less than 0.05, normally distributed
shapiro.test(plots$ts_density[plots$treatment == "caged"]) #normally distributed 
shapiro.test(plots$ts_density[plots$treatment == "open"]) #normally distributed 

#t-test to compare urchin densities between treatments
t_test_result  <- t.test(ts_density ~ treatment, data = plots) 
t_test_result

p_value <- formatC(t_test_result$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)
#calculate values for reporting 
#calculate the mean and standard error for each treatment
summary_stats <- plots %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(ts_density, na.rm = TRUE),  # Mean of urchin density
    sd_density = sd(ts_density, na.rm = TRUE),      # Standard deviation of urchin density
    n = n(),                                           # Sample size
    sem = sd_density / sqrt(n)                         # Standard error of the mean
  )

#print summary statistics to check the results
print(summary_stats)

#get values for open and caged treatments
open_stats <- summary_stats %>% filter(treatment == "open")
caged_stats <- summary_stats %>% filter(treatment == "caged")

#calculate and format the report output
open_report <- paste(open_stats$mean_density, "±", round(open_stats$sem, 2), "ind/m²")
caged_report <- paste(caged_stats$mean_density, "±", round(caged_stats$sem, 2), "ind/m²")

#make a barchat instead - plots mean and standard deviation 
# Calculate mean and standard deviation for each treatment
summary_stats <- plots %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_ts_density = mean(ts_density, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_ts_density = sd(ts_density, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),  # Sample size

    )

    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = pmax(mean_ts_density - se_ts_density, 0),  # Ensure lower bound is zero
            ymax = mean_ts_density + se_ts_density
        ),
        width = 0.2,  # Width of the error bar
        color = "black",
        position = position_dodge(0.7)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Turban Snail Density by Treatment",
        x = "Treatment",
        y = "Turban Snail Density (m²)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("caged" = "#FF5733", "open" = "#076fa6")) +

        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),  # Increase x-axis label size
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")  # Increase y-axis label size
    )

plot
```

```{r}
# Calculate mean ts density per site
mean_density_per_site <- transects %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_ts_density = mean(ts_site_density, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#plot 
#reorder months in chronological order
transects$month <- factor(transects$month, levels = c("March", "April", "May", "June"))

#calculate mean ts density per site
mean_ts_density <- transects %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(mean_density = mean(ts_site_density, na.rm = TRUE))

#calculate overall mean ts density across all sites and months
overall_mean_density <- mean(transects$ts_site_density, na.rm = TRUE)
overall_mean_density #3.08

#create the plot
plot <- ggplot(transects, aes(x = month, y = ts_site_density, color = site, group = site)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # Plot site mean values as points, change x to "mean"
  geom_point(data = mean_ts_density, 
             aes(x = "mean", y = mean_density, color = site), 
             shape = 17, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Hide legend for mean points
  # Add labels for site mean values with better positioning to avoid overlap
  geom_text_repel(data = mean_ts_density, 
                  aes(x = "mean", y = mean_density, label = round(mean_density, 2), color = site), 
                  vjust = -2, hjust = 0.2, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, 
                  box.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 10) +  # Prevent text overlap
  # Add the overall mean line and text
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = overall_mean_density), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +  # Add overall mean line
  # Add overall mean text with better positioning
  geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = overall_mean_density, label = paste("Overall Mean:", round(overall_mean_density, 2))),
            color = "black", vjust = +2.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +  # Adjust position for the text label
  labs(
    title = "Turban Density by Month Across Sites",
    x = "Month",
    y = "ts Density (m²)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("March", "April", "May", "June", "mean")) +  # Add "mean" to x-axis labels
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
